judge.voice: Dobrý den. I like that the help is there and it speaks slowly: Leo says short things, and the button gave me "How was school today?" and I could say it to my grandson. I did not have to leave the room, which I like. But the quiz showed words Leo did not say, and I was confused. Nobody told me what I said wrong — "I like dog, is good" — and I wanted to try again with a new question, but the scene just ended. I would use it on Saturday for ten minutes, because it is about my Leo and not the course book. I would tell a friend, but I would say: needs a teacher's little note at the end.

verdictWhy.text: D2 failed: Cue helped him reach 'How is school?' (#8), but no coaching note exists: moments [], coaching null; nothing quotes 'Yes Leo, I like dog. Is good.' (#9).
verdictWhy.check: The help actually unblocks the next reply; a coaching note quotes what they really said.

verdictWhy.text: D3 failed: No moment and no replay happened; rawMoments all kind 'none'. No fresh question was given for a retry.
